title: Design: A/P Detail with a bucket open matches the pictures in both themes
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, with {Location-A} as your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The organization has open documents in these reports at two locations, {Location-A} and {Location-B}, and you are enrolled at both; {Location-A}'s name comes first in A to Z order.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 and {Location-B} is Staging Lethbridge - 4310.
  • The "91 or more days past due" bucket has more lines than fit on the screen on today's date.
    For example: the QA organization (11,334 lines in that bucket).
  • Starting screen: A/P Detail (Reports, then "A/P Aging Detail" under ACCOUNTS PAYABLE in the left menu) is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu in light theme at 100% zoom, with "91 or more days past due" expanded.
  • The design pictures "Open Balance pinned, light" (ar-ap-p6-open-balance-pinned-light.png) and "Same, dark" (ar-ap-p6-same-dark-2.png) are attached to this case and open beside the browser at 100% zoom; compare the layout, labels and styles, not the names and amounts, which are only examples.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Scroll down a little inside the bucket.
  2. Switch ShopView to dark theme.
  3. Widen the browser window to 1536 px and look across the page.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the bucket row "91 or more days past due" stays pinned under the column headings, and the bold Totals row sits at the bottom while the rows scroll under it. Compared with the light picture: all nine columns show at 1440 px: the chevron, "Date", "Location", "Transaction Type", "No.", "Vendor Name" with a small up arrow, "Due Date", "Past Due", "Amount", "Open Balance", each heading on one line; Location wraps onto two lines (for example "Staging Heavy" / "Duty - 9919"); dates, numbers and money stay on one line; document numbers are blue links; Open Balance is bold on every row.
  • Step 2: the page switches to dark theme, as in the dark picture: the links are blue and readable on the dark page; Open Balance and the Totals row bold and white.
  • Step 3: nothing overlaps, is cut off or clipped; the layout is the same as at 1440 px.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 5 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11532 (Story 2, Sort by clicking any column header), story SV-11534 (Story 4, Collapse all, Expand all and pinned group rows), story SV-11537 (Story 7, Document links open where they can), story SV-11538 (Story 8, Report descriptions and layout)

  • S8-R3: “The headline column (Open Balance; Total on the Summaries) is pinned to the right edge and bold on the header, every row, every expanded row and the Totals row, as on Sales By Customer. At 1440 pixels wide every column of all six reports is visible without scrolling sideways: the customer or vendor name and Transaction type wrap long values onto a second line, Location wraps only on A/P Detail (nine columns), column headings never wrap, and money, date and number columns never wrap. Narrower than 1440 pixels, the table scrolls sideways under the pinned column.”
  • S8-R4: “The Totals row uses the native totals row style of the newer reports.”
  • S4-R6: “While the user scrolls through an expanded group, that group's row (the bucket label, customer or vendor) stays pinned just under the column headings. Only one group row is held at a time: when the next group's row reaches it, the next row pushes it up and off and takes its place. Scrolling back reverses this.”
  • S7-R7: “Links use the native report link style (the same blue as Work In Progress, semi-bold, no underline, underlined only on keyboard focus), readable in light and dark theme.”
  • S2-R1, A/P Detail and A/P Unpaid Invoices columns: “A/P Detail and A/P Unpaid Invoices: Date, Location (when shown), Transaction Type, No., Vendor Name, Due Date, Past Due, Amount, Open Balance.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "A/R and A/P Report Sorting" (https://claude.ai/artifact/BRYCdjKwGRSgGPC9xxkgF4), read 22 Oct 2026: page 6 "Descriptions and pinned column" (board Layout.dc.html). Compare the screen with the pictures below at 100% zoom; the expected results still come from the PRD quotes above, the pictures give the look and the on-screen labels.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • ar-ap-p6-open-balance-pinned-light.png: figure "Open Balance pinned, light" (This build (after)), board "6. Report descriptions and the pinned headline column"
  • ar-ap-p6-same-dark-2.png: figure "Same, dark" (This build (after)), board "6. Report descriptions and the pinned headline column"
  • ar-ap-p6-a-p-detail-scrolled-sideways-light.png: figure "A/P Detail scrolled sideways, light" (Production (before)), board "6. Report descriptions and the pinned headline column" (today's look, for comparison only)

The design's own words:

  • "The headline column (Open Balance; Total on the Summaries) is bold and pinned right; the group label stays at the left. S8-R3, S8-R4, S4-R7." (caption of "Open Balance pinned, light")
  • "Pinned cells and links use the native colors in dark mode. S8-R3, S7-R7." (caption of "Same, dark")
  • "No description anywhere; no column stays in place." (caption of "A/P Detail scrolled sideways, light")

Difference from the PRD (DD-05): the PRD says "the same blue as Work In Progress, semi-bold, no underline" (S7-R7); the design shows document numbers and customer and vendor names are blue at the same (regular) weight as the plain text beside them. This case follows the PRD; the difference is question 15 on Chris Ward's question sheet (added 22 Oct 2026); the design version is held in D-80.

Design note (DR-01): the design shows the Totals row sits on a light-grey band in some pictures (A/R Collection expanded, A/P Detail, A/P Unpaid Invoices, A/R Detail I32) and on the page colour in others (Summaries, I28, the same A/R Detail screen in I30). Closed without a question: PRD S8-R4: "The Totals row uses the native totals row style of the newer reports." The cases compare with Sales By Customer's Totals row; the pictures are not the reference for this one attribute.
